opening.argument: The presentation gives concrete instructions for joining the Forsage cryptocurrency and blockchain system, including connecting a network and blockchain and directing viewers to an external link. It describes purchasing a $10 block together with group income and refers to a downline-based process, showing participation through recruitment commissions and tiered earnings. The speaker also states that income comes from investing in the system and claims, "I will get 100% guarantee by using crypto currency." Those participation instructions and unusually strong return assurance establish promotional solicitation, while the blockchain explanation does not displace the dominant investment and recruitment message.
